limitations: Purpose-bound semantic relations (counterparty_identity_verdict, invoice_contract_association, contract_active_for_exposure, contract_acquisition_relevant_term, contract_obligation_kind, counterparty_current_relationship, commercial_dependency_status) were not persisted in 06_world/world.sqlite per P6 admission; derive_purposes.py loads ACCEPT/REJECT/UNRESOLVED verdicts from 05_dispositions.json.

Two Northbridge commercial_relationship_path candidates remain UNRESOLVED in 05_dispositions and were not asserted to World; Purpose B links for Northbridge still come from disposition packets for counterparty_identity_verdict.
REJECT commercial_dependency_status rows are omitted from Purpose C output (status vocabulary is dependent | unresolved only).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical boolean from source_invoice.status; no unresolved branch.
derivations.required_premise: source_invoice.status is present for every invoice.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic prefix billing: concatenated with exact billed_name.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One row per distinct billed_name in source_invoice.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Deterministic prefix crm: concatenated with crm_account_id.
Deterministic prefix registry: concatenated with company_number.
Deterministic prefix contract: concatenated with contract_stem.
Enumerates adjacent mandated identifier pairs along each commercial_relationship_path; does not assign epistemic verdict.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Complete for asserted commercial_relationship_path rows in World; unresolved path candidates omitted.
derivations.required_premise: At least one asserted commercial_relationship_path with resolvable identifier forms for crm, billing, contract, and registry roles.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_counterparty_name supports billing-to-contract counterparty name links when contract id alone is insufficient.
blocking_unresolved_state: commercial_relationship_path with UNRESOLVED disposition (path not emitted, links along that path absent)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose B policy verdict per link: SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED; missing positive evidence is not DISTINCT.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One verdict per required_reconciliation_link candidate; sourced from P5 disposition packets when not in World.
derivations.optional_enrichment: source_commercial_note and registry grounding for mechanical legal-form and explicit same/distinct assertions.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: UNRESOLVED epistemic on a link pair (emitted in Purpose B output; does not block row emission)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: association is asserted only when invoice-to-contract and billed-name-to-counterparty linkage is confident; otherwise unresolved without negative inference.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Candidate per source_invoice with plausible contract from commercial_relationship_path or notes.
derivations.optional_enrichment: commercial notes and identity verdicts for name-variant joins.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: association unresolved (invoice still eligible for Purpose A output when contract meets exposure thresholds)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A policy: expired SOW is not active; follows grounded in_force otherwise.
derivations.optional_enrichment: source_commercial_note corroboration for expired SOW exclusion.
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_in_force UNRESOLVED (cannot classify active for exposure)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A threshold over CoC and assignment feature families; has_relevant_term when any family matches.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Candidates are contracts with clause_encodes_feature in CoC or assignment families.
derivations.required_premise: At least one grounded clause_encodes_feature row for the contract.
derivations.optional_enrichment: contract_section_clause text for ambiguous feature readings.
blocking_unresolved_state: clause_encodes_feature UNRESOLVED for all CoC/assignment sections on contract

derivations.epistemic_behavior: qualifies when invoice links (asserted or unresolved) to a contract that is active for exposure and bears acquisition-relevant terms.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every qualifying invoice appears exactly once in Purpose A output.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_contract_association row with association asserted or unresolved; contract passes both Purpose A contract gates.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: invoice_contract_association unresolved (row still qualifies for output)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Maps contract to closed vocabulary exclusivity | auto_renewal | rolling_term.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Zero or more kinds per contract; only ACCEPT dispositions emitted.
derivations.required_premise: Grounded exclusivity, auto-renewal, or rolling term evidence.
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_obligation_kind UNRESOLVED (kind omitted; may block dependent status if no kind remains)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: true when open invoice exists or in-force contract auto-renews/rolls; false when expired contract and no open invoice.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One verdict per billing: counterparty appearing in commercial paths.
derivations.required_premise: Counterparty billing identifier and at least one invoice or contract observation.
blocking_unresolved_state: contract_in_force UNRESOLVED when assessing contract-only prong

derivations.epistemic_behavior: status dependent when both prongs hold; unresolved when identity join blocks assessment; never false negative from missing identity.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Emit row for each counterparty-contract pair that is dependent or unresolved per Purpose C inclusion rules.
derivations.required_premise: counterparty_current_relationship true and at least one contract_obligation_kind on same contract_id.
derivations.optional_enrichment: invoice_contract_association for unresolved propagation on invoice-contract joins.
blocking_unresolved_state: counterparty_identity_verdict UNRESOLVED on billing-to-contract link for the row (forces status unresolved)
invoice_contract_association unresolved when open invoices must be tied (forces status unresolved)
non_blocking_unresolved_state: counterparty_identity_verdict UNRESOLVED on crm-to-billing link when billing-to-contract is asserted (does not block dependent if billing-contract join is confident)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Lists open invoice_id values for a dependency row when association is asserted.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: All open invoices with asserted association to the contract on the dependency row.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_is_open true and invoice_contract_association asserted for matching contract_id.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: invoice_contract_association unresolved (open_invoice_ids empty; handled at commercial_dependency_status level)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: JSON exposure report; association field is asserted or unresolved; sorted by invoice_id ascending.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every invoice_exposure_qualifies row rendered with all scalar invoice fields.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: JSON link list with epistemic SAME_ENTITY | DISTINCT | UNRESOLVED; sorted by left then right ascending.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Every required reconciliation link has an explicit verdict; no omission for uncertainty.
derivations.required_premise: counterparty_identity_verdict row for each required link.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: JSON dependency rows with status dependent or unresolved; obligation_kinds sorted ascending; rows sorted by contract_id.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Dependent and unresolved inclusion rows only; REJECT pairs omitted.
blocking_unresolved_state: Identity unresolved on billing-to-contract join forces status unresolved
non_blocking_unresolved_state: crm-to-billing UNRESOLVED when billing-to-contract is asserted
